sourceAreaClassifications.include: Reservation consumer proof source or configuration that may remain with the separated consumer app.
sourceAreaClassifications.exclude: Backend platform, compatibility route, storage, provider, migration, or monorepo infrastructure source that a separated frontend repo must not need.
sourceAreaClassifications.reference-only: Current-app owned source, documentation, tests, or proof fixtures that explain the migration but are not included in this reservation consumer repo proof.

dependencyClassifications.frontend-runtime: Runtime package that a separated frontend repo may need.
dependencyClassifications.frontend-dev: Development, typecheck, lint, or test package that a separated frontend repo may need.
dependencyClassifications.sdk-consumer: Published SDK or public contract package expected to replace workspace/internal imports.
dependencyClassifications.backend-only-excluded: Backend platform, provider, storage, database, or workflow package excluded from the separated frontend repo.
dependencyClassifications.current-monorepo-only: Package kept for the current monorepo proof harness or legacy app modules but not required by the frontend consumer repository.
